claire: FYI 3 planned maintenance + SLO tweak Tue 2026-04-14 01:30-03:00 UTC. We're doing a regional failover rehearsal and rebaselining a subset of p99 SLOs for small-gen routes. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/sre-maint-2026 (internal). Please ack if you own any high-throughput routes that must be excluded. :loud_sound:
hiro: Ack. Which routes are in scope for the SLO change?
claire: Scope: small-gen (/v1/generate-small) and chat-lite. We'll trial new p99 from 850ms -> 950ms for a 14-day probation. The failover rehearsal will shift 20% traffic us-east-1 -> us-west-2 in two stages.
ops-eng: We'll enable quiet-window 01:15-03:30 UTC. Embeddings are excluded. Deploy-bot: Scheduled job: maintenance-failover-2026-04-14-01:30. CI green.
sre_oncall: Status blurb draft: "Planned regional failover and SLO probation; customers may see brief latency increases on affected routes. Monitoring active; no data loss expected."
hiro: Rollback criteria?
claire: Abort if 5xx > 1% sustained for 10m, or p99 for high-priority routes > 1.5s for 5m. Post-checks: KV hit-rate >= 90% within 10m and queue depth stable.
ops-eng: I'll update routing-exclusions and watch rollback triggers.
claire: Final reminder Fri 09:00 PT. Flag exclusions here before Thu EOD. Live updates will be posted in this thread during the window.
